The art style uses clean, bold line work typical of manga, with minimal shading achieved through screentone patterns. The character's facial expression appears contemplative or possibly distressed. Below this main image is a smaller panel showing what appears to be the same or similar character in a different pose, with visible text that reads 'WHERE DID' suggesting dialogue or internal monologue. The overall composition uses strong contrasts between black lines and white/screentoned areas, creating a dramatic visual effect characteristic of manga artwork.
